zh.name: 主题资源收藏清单
zh.summary: 围绕一个明确目的挑选可访问的资源，每项给名称、真实预览和值得打开的理由。
zh.useWhen: 资源可独立使用，不要求按顺序操作；书、网站、视频只是同一结构的素材变体。
zh.instructions: 资源名称、链接、预览、筛选理由与使用门槛
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Curated Resource List
en.summary: Create an Instagram list carousel using the curated resource list structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the curated resource list format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 奶油色褶皱纸底和钴蓝文字
